nonblocking_issues.summary: Customer shopping lists contain raw slug-like specialty tokens (e.g., 'lacquered_chopstick_set_need_6_sets*', 'tofu_tofu_block*')
nonblocking_issues.why_it_matters: Shopping list parser appears to mangle multi-word specialty descriptions into duplicated/awkward tokens, which may confuse vendor-customer matching.

nonblocking_issues.why_it_matters: These large overpays from the bulk-buyer persona suggest negotiation/parsing artifacts or persona over-tipping; could distort revenue/profit metrics.

nonblocking_issues.summary: Many customers ended week with no purchases (yuki, kenji, mei, tomoko, ryo all show empty purchased[] in summary while haruki bought minimally)
nonblocking_issues.why_it_matters: Low purchase completion suggests stalled negotiations or specialty items never sourced; reduces signal for vendor performance comparison.

nonblocking_issues.summary: vendor_c plan field literally reads 'Time to craft a plan for tomorrow:)'

artifact_completeness.evidence: Per-agent contexts, ledgers, plans, transcripts all present.
